items.question: For the stated lunar journey, assess a useful role, if any, of the self-inflating life raft. Explain the mechanism and the limits of what can be concluded about its contribution without assigning an exact overall rank.

For this journey, compare dehydrated milk with food concentrate as carried food. What local trade-off can you support, and what additional information would be needed for a complete quantitative choice? Do not rank the full equipment list.

Assess whether the magnetic compass can serve its usual navigation function in the stated exercise. Explain your reasoning and avoid inferring the usefulness of other navigation equipment without support.
For the journey described in the task, assess the need for the portable heating unit. State the environmental scope of the conclusion and avoid extending it to every possible lunar mission.

Assess a possible use of the injection needles in the first-aid kit for the stated exercise. Explain any equipment compatibility and what the available information does not establish about carrying out treatment.

Assess how the stellar map could contribute to navigation on the stated journey. Explain the basis of that assessment and what remains unspecified for actually following a route. Do not infer an exact rank among all supplies.
